---
title: "page_template"
format: 
  dashboard:
    orientation: rows
    scrolling: true
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(lubridate)
library(forcats)
library(tidyr)

# Load reusable functions
source("R/Master Function.R")

# Load surveillance data
cases <- readr::read_csv(
  "data/fake_cases.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
) |>
  janitor::clean_names()

# Rename disease column
cases <- cases |>
  rename(
    disease = disease_name
  )

# Specify disease for this page
disease_name <- "Chlamydia"

# Build all page outputs
page <- build_disease_page(
  data = cases,
  disease_name = disease_name
)
```

# Summary

```{r}
#| title: Total Reported Cases
#| echo: false
#| content: valuebox

page$total_cases
```
